name: whisper-large-v3-ar
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.61 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-05-23. CAVEATS: Quran/Hadith are the authors' own frozen validation splits scored with the authors' own Arabic normalizer (eval/asr_score.py), so WER is normalizer-dependent and not comparable to other Arabic ASR numbers. The 12x Quran gain is largely domain memorization of recited text. On general broadcast MSA it is competitive, not leading - Cohere Transcribe Arabic gets 6.77 WER vs this model's 9.52.
